description.value:
A large-caliber, well-balanced rifle coveted by pros and wannabes alike. This hardware sells for top-shelf prices, but because it's a weapon of choice within multiple agencies, there's little doubt it's worth every enny. Once you get your hands on one, everything else will feel like clunky scrap metal by comparison.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: All Ammunition fired from this weapon also functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6) and expends 3 rounds in a burst. Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded and cause the Torn Muscle Critical Injury when fired.

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
